query: Turn on content approval and 50 major versions for the Policies library. Show me the plan first.
expected_behavior: Runs or hands over scripts/spo-configure-library-settings.ps1 with -PlanPath and without -Execute, as a dry run
States the dry run prints a structured JSON action plan and makes zero tenant writes
Does not supply a confirmation token until the user asks for the real run

query: The plan looks right. Apply it for real.
expected_behavior: Adds -Execute and -ConfirmToken CONFIGURE-SPO-LIBRARY-SETTINGS to the same command
Treats the real run as a live tenant write that the user runs, not something to run unprompted
Does not alter the plan content between the dry run and the real run

query: Which settings does this change, and which does it leave alone?
expected_behavior: Limits itself to version limits, content approval and draft visibility
Points to the list-settings skill for title, description and general versioning of a list
Makes no change without -Execute and the token
